# Report errata 1

Presentation corrections only. No analysis was rerun, and no committed results file was edited. Values below are read from `audit/gru_v1_3/results/results.json`.

## Constants

Two figures in `REPORT.md` differ from spec section 7 because that report prints with 16 significant digits. The stored constants match the spec:

| quantity | displayed in REPORT.md | value in results.json (spec section 7) |
|---|---|---|
| Var_w(q) | 0.1676122314305234 | 0.16761223143052342 |
| R²-gain floor | 0.03474613777282005 | 0.034746137772820054 |

R_oracle in results.json is 0.5823877685694766 and the floor is 0.005823877685694766. Those two already match the displayed report and spec section 7.

## Integrity wording

The wording 'No (PR, seed) block is UNRESOLVED' should read: **No integrity unit is UNRESOLVED.**

The integrity-failure unit is (PR, seed). In these results, no integrity unit is UNRESOLVED.

## Completeness

`results.json` records `audit_complete` true for the scheduled S0, P, D, and report outputs. That statement needs this caveat: the 112/112 consistency re-check could not run in this checkout until the predecessor files were added in the follow-up after the results. The numerical audit was not rerun.

## INIT tier

The 60 INIT checkpoints are rendered here from `results.json`. `REPORT.md` prints a 16-significant-digit form of each of these blocks and shows `label=None`. This listing is the stored form. INIT is descriptive only. No meets-floor, below-floor, or BOUNDARY label is issued. `label` is null in the JSON and is not a floor label.
